# slack_user (Data Source)

Looks up a Slack user by ID or email address. Exactly one of id or email must be set. Looking up by email requires the users:read and users:read.email scopes, and does not find deactivated users.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Email address of the user. Looked up with users.lookupByEmail. Conflicts with id. Read-only when the user is looked up by id, and empty if the token lacks the users:read.email scope.
- `id` (String) ID of the user, for example U0123456789. Looked up with users.info. Conflicts with email.

### Read-Only

- `deleted` (Boolean) Whether the user has been deactivated.
- `has_2fa` (Boolean) Whether the user has two-factor authentication enabled.
- `has_files` (Boolean) Whether the user has uploaded files.
- `is_admin` (Boolean) Whether the user is a workspace admin.
- `is_app_user` (Boolean) Whether the user is an app user.
- `is_bot` (Boolean) Whether the user is a bot.
- `is_invited_user` (Boolean) Whether the user has been invited but has not yet joined.
- `is_owner` (Boolean) Whether the user is a workspace owner.
- `is_primary_owner` (Boolean) Whether the user is the primary owner of the workspace.
- `is_restricted` (Boolean) Whether the user is a guest (multi-channel or single-channel).
- `is_stranger` (Boolean) Whether the user belongs to another workspace and is reached through Slack Connect.
- `is_ultra_restricted` (Boolean) Whether the user is a single-channel guest.
- `locale` (String) Locale of the user, for example en-US.
- `name` (String) Username (handle) of the user.
- `presence` (String) Presence of the user as reported by Slack. Slack has deprecated this field in the user object, so it is usually empty.
- `real_name` (String, Sensitive) Real name of the user.
- `team_id` (String) ID of the workspace the user belongs to.
- `two_factor_type` (String) Two-factor authentication method of the user, such as app or sms. Null when two-factor authentication is off.
